definitions.gloss: advance payment; prepayment; paying in advance
definitions.explanation: Payment made before goods are delivered or services are rendered. Composed of 前 (before) + 払い (payment). The opposite of 後払い (payment after receipt).

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{店|みせ}→店：00497_mise⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{前払|まえばら}いです。
examples.english: This shop requires payment in advance.

examples.japanese: ⟦{家賃|やちん}→家賃：03639_yachin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{毎月|まいつき}→毎月：00732_maitsuki⟧{前払|まえばら}い⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{振|ふ}り{込|こ}んでいる→振り込む：10992_furikomu⟧。
examples.english: I transfer the rent by prepayment every month.

examples.japanese: {前払|まえばら}い⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{割引|わりびき}→割引：01526_waribiki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{適用|てきよう}される→適用する：21739_tekiyousuru⟧⟦サービス→サービス：01531_saabisu⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: Some services offer a discount if you pay in advance.

notes:
USAGE:
{前払|まえばら}い is used as a noun or a no-adjective: {前払|まえばら}い⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{料金|りょうきん}→料金：03797_ryoukin⟧ (prepaid charge). It can also function as a suru-verb in some contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {前払|まえばら}い⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{払|はら}う→払う：00535_harau⟧ (pay in advance)
- {前払|まえばら}い⟦{制|せい}→〜制：30791_sei⟧ (prepayment system)
- {前払|まえばら}い{式|しき} (prepaid type)

SIMILAR WORDS:
⟦{後払|あとばら}い→後払い：17771_atobarai⟧ means "deferred payment" or "pay later" — the opposite of {前払|まえばら}い. ⟦{先払|さきばら}い→先払い：26930_sakibarai⟧ also means "advance payment" and is used interchangeably in many contexts. プリペイド is the loanword for "prepaid" and is common for cards and phone plans.
